overall: The AG found the Brookline Advisory Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside a posted meeting through TMMA Listserv posts, but cautioned that social media must not be used to facilitate quorum discussion.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleges Committee members deliberated outside a posted meeting via posts on the closed TMMA Listserv about a new Pierce School.
allegations.key_passage: Given the lack of evidence showing deliberation between or among a quorum of the Committee, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law.
